items.headline: Stocks rebound as chipmakers snap an eight-day losing streak
items.note: On Monday the S&P 500 rose 0.4%, the Nasdaq about 1.1% and the Dow was roughly flat. The Philadelphia semiconductor index gained about 1.6%, ending its longest losing streak since 2008, though roughly 70% of S&P stocks were lower at one point, so the gain was narrow.

items.headline: Fed enters quiet period; markets expect a hold on Oct 28 but see more hikes ahead
items.note: Saxo says markets are pricing three 25bp hikes by next July, and the 10-year Treasury yield rose nearly 7bp to 5.14%. Brent crude is near $110, which keeps inflation worries alive and pressures tech valuations.

items.headline: Anthropic study: junior hiring in technical roles has dropped sharply
items.note: Anthropic reports junior staff fell from 21% to 14% of its technical departments since early 2025, and junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9%. For internship seekers, entry-level bars are rising, so projects and real skills matter.

items.headline: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public-benefit fund
items.note: The fund is subject to stockholder approval. AI Weekly says the company is heading toward a November IPO.

items.headline: Disney to hire most of Character.AI's staff after its bankruptcy filing
items.note: TechCrunch reports Disney will offer jobs to at least 60 employees and is the $20 million lead bidder for a license to the startup's code. Big companies are absorbing talent from struggling AI startups.

items.headline: OpenAI confirms it will build a humanoid robot
items.note: Sam Altman told Fortune 'we will definitely do a humanoid'; Engadget reports a demo is targeted for 2027, with OpenAI listing 27 robotics roles.

items.headline: Reflection AI open-weights Beam, a 501B-parameter model
items.note: The Apache 2.0 model uses 23B active parameters; the company claims about 80% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (a company claim). Free to download and test.

items.headline: US cybersecurity postings fall 26%, but AI security roles surge
items.note: SecurityWeek says postings hit a four-year low of 235,786 in the first nine months of 2026 while AI Security Engineer demand rose 268.3% year over year.

items.headline: Big earnings week: Netflix, Meta, Tesla, IBM
items.note: Per Saxo, Netflix reports Tuesday; Meta, Tesla, Lam Research, Texas Instruments and IBM Wednesday; Western Digital and Spotify Thursday. Their AI spending comments could move chip stocks either way.

learn.explain: An IPO is when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time and lists on a stock exchange. The company raises money, and early investors and employees can finally sell shares. Banks help set the opening price, and the stock can jump or drop on day one. Today's AI Weekly report says Anthropic is heading toward a November IPO, which is why its plan to give 5% of its shares to a public-benefit fund is in the news. Before an IPO, ordinary investors generally can't buy a company's stock at all.
learn.try: Look up a recent big tech IPO and compare its IPO price to its first-day closing price.
